Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Classic Flush Mount, 6.25"H, Bronze
Colors: Bronze
Materials: Glass
11"W x 11"D x 6.25"H The classic simplicity of this flush-mounted ceiling light design is offset by trendy watered glass panes to create the perfect outdoor fixture. Hardwired; 2 S60 60-watt maximum vintage incandescent bulbs included Expert installation required Outdoor and indoor use; mounting hardware included
